configure_azure_openai_valves: configure Azure OpenAI connection settings using Pipeline.Valves with API key, endpoint, version, models, and model names
build_azure_openai_pipelines: build a list of pipeline entries from semicolon-separated model IDs and display names via Pipeline.set_pipelines
run_azure_openai_chat_completion: run a chat completion request against Azure OpenAI API through Pipeline.pipe with streaming or non-streaming response
review_azure_openai_parameter_filtering: review Pipeline.pipe parameter filtering that drops unsupported fields before forwarding to Azure OpenAI
test_azure_openai_lifecycle_hooks: test Pipeline.on_startup and Pipeline.on_shutdown lifecycle hooks for server start and stop events
